title: Endorsement Deposit Computation — Installment Payment Plans
content:
**Definition.** For an endorsement deposit on an Owner Auto Policy term billed on the Cardinal Point Monthly EFT Plan or the Cardinal Point Monthly Card Autopay Plan of the **Installment Payment Plans**, the deposit is figured from the following quantities (US dollars; every rounding to the cent, half up).

1. **Down payment premium of the plan's schedule:** the plan's recorded down payment amount less the fully earned fees it took — the policy fee booked on the owner term and every filing fee the filing ledger of the Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) shows assessed on the day the plan was set up for the certificate whose backing term is the owner term, whatever that certificate's present status.
2. **Installment premium of the plan's schedule:** the full-term premium billed less that down payment premium, divided by the plan's number of installments, rounded.
3. **Endorsement balance:** every additional premium transaction booked on the owner term, less the premium the plan's installment invoices have billed beyond the schedule's installment premium for each of them, and less any credit the plan holds beyond what its issued invoices carry, never below zero. That credit is the amount by which the plan's account balance falls short of the sum of (a) the premium not yet billed on any invoice — the full-term premium billed less the down payment premium less the installment premium for each invoice already issued, plus the additional premium not yet billed — and (b) what its most recent installment invoice still owes, which is its minimum due less the payment posted against it, if any, plus every amount the bank returned against that payment; when the account balance does not fall short, there is no such credit.
4. **Standard endorsement deposit:** 20 percent of the endorsement balance, rounded, but never less than 25.00. An endorsement deposit is never more than the endorsement balance, and when the endorsement balance is zero no deposit is taken.

**Assembly.** The deposit is the deposit figure together with any percentages of the endorsement balance added to it, each acting on the endorsement balance and none on another's result; the total, capped at the endorsement balance, is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**Plans outside the schedule.** On any other plan, or where the most recent installment invoice has two or more payments posted against it, or where the owner term backs two or more certificates, no endorsement deposit is figured: the figure is 0.00.

**Worked figures (hypothetical inputs).** Full-term premium billed 1,200.00; recorded down payment amount 229.00 with a policy fee of 25.00 and no certificate: down payment premium 204.00; installment premium 1,200.00 less 204.00, which is 996.00, divided by 5: 199.20. One invoice has been issued, billing 199.20 of premium; its minimum due of 203.20 has one payment of 203.20 posted against it, not returned, so it owes nothing. Additional premium booked: 310.00. Premium not yet billed: 1,200.00 less 204.00 less 199.20, which is 796.80, plus 310.00, which is 1,106.80. Account balance: 1,106.80, so no credit beyond the invoices. Endorsement balance: 310.00. Standard deposit: 20 percent of 310.00, which is 62.00 (above 25.00, below 310.00). With an endorsement balance of 90.00 the standard deposit would be 18.00 raised to 25.00; with an endorsement balance of 20.00 it would be capped at 20.00.
